releases.body:
5.1.49 and 5.1.50 were not published; their changes ship here.

Session startup and task RPC attachment no longer wait for task-host liveness probes. Recovery runs independently per host, stops claiming or reviving children after shutdown, and preserves newer ownership claims. ([#11335](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11335)) DAG recovery and workpool reconciliation now wait for that same session-start reconcile (one shared gate) without holding admission, so a paused DAG's revivable child is never judged orphaned and a queued workpool item of an orphaned worker is redelivered rather than marked delivery_uncertain. ([#11525](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11525))

Continuing a synchronous task whose session was already deleted now fails at once with an error saying to start a new task, instead of waiting out the 30-minute sync poll timeout; a sync poll also stops when the server keeps reporting its session as not found. Completed sync task sessions now honor `background_task.taskCleanupDelayMs` instead of a fixed 10 minutes. Reported by @orgito. ([#11524](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11524), fixes [#11520](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11520))

**omo.dev deploys again after the document-shell change.** The `/design` showcase became a root layout of its own and lost the hourly revalidation it used to inherit, so one prerendered page had no expiry and the deploy's asset-retention check refused the build. The design layout revalidates hourly again, within the site's one-hour HTML lifetime. ([#11587](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11587), fixes [#11585](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11585))

Release pull requests no longer fail the changelog gate when fragments for the next release land on the base branch after the cut. ([#11574](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11574))

- Release preparation no longer fails its own command-string audit when changelog fragments have been folded into the changelog. ([#11562](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11562))

**The frontend skill now builds in ten habits that design reviewers check for.** Before designing a new screen, a redesign, or a design system, it reads the guideline source in full, defines the ideal state per persona and journey step, and records every gap in a ledger. Controls keep the same box size in every state, and a spinner or arrow never adds padding. Pointer targets are at least 24 px, colour roles come before components (built from shadcn/ui anatomy), glass and dated trend surfaces stay out unless the brief asks for them, and the subtract pass counts the controls. Every UI or design-system deliverable states a per-criterion WCAG 2.2 AA result. ([#11536](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11536), fixes [#11534](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11534))

**macOS computer use releases the keys and buttons it holds even if the engine dies mid-call.** An input request that presses now starts the engine binary again as a hidden release helper and streams every press, drag move and release to it; when the engine is killed, crashes or a request unwinds with something still held, the helper posts the releases (within 2 seconds) through the same routes, leaving any key or button the user is physically holding to the user. The helper runs in its own session, ignores the hangup and terminate a group kill sends until its releases are out, and refuses to run unless the engine that spawned it is its parent and the stream carries its per-spawn token. Other platforms are unchanged. ([#11535](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11535))

**A process child whose provider has no usable sign-in now moves on to the next provider instead of failing.** When the engine refuses a child's first prompt with `provider_credentials_missing` or `provider_credentials_expired`, t

**OmO Native stops waiting on a stalled turn-end subscriber after two seconds.** Memory recovery remains retryable without treating the cancelled wait as a failed reflection run, and stall diagnostics identify the component and hook instead of only `omo.js`. Thanks to @floweredao for the report. ([#11254](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11254), Part of [#11249](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11249)) ([#11280](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11280))

**Warm memory prompts avoid repeated git processes for HEAD and agreements.** Committed agreement reads are cached by repository and full revision, and cache misses inspect only the ledger path. Standard file-backed HEADs resolve from stat-validated Git files, including packed refs and linked worktrees, with git fallback for unusual layouts. ([#11216](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11216), part of [#10707](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10707)) ([#11280](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11280))

**Unchanged memory notices no longer yield a warm prompt to cold recall.** Soul and agreement notices read their small atomic watermarks directly and skip lock acquisition only when valid state confirms nothing needs announcing or updating. Missing, malformed, or unreadable state is rechecked under the identity lock. Writers publish through unique, exclusively created temporary files, flush them before rename, and sync the directory where supported. ([#11215](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11215), part of [#10707](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10707)) ([#11280](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11280))

**Memory notices survive a directory-sync failure after publication.** Soul and agreement watermarks still flush before atomic rename and attempt directory sync, but a sync error after publication is logged without discarding that turn's announcement. Failed writes clean up their temporary files, repeated agreement ids use set comparison, and HEAD reads defer to git for worktree configuration. ([#11234](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11234), part of [#10707](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10707)) ([#11280](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11280))

**Nested in-process tasks retain their original session tree.** A child's own tasks now record the tree root and increasing depth, so nested delegation obeys `max_depth` instead of restarting at depth 1. The root session's own view now also covers its nested in-process descendants: the footer, `/tasks`, the default `task_output` list, and `task_send` and cancel. Process-mode descendants already appeared there. ([#11226](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11226)) ([#11280](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11280))

**Nested team members retain the original session tree.** A child session leading a team now gives each member its own session as parent and the original tree root, with depth increasing from the lead. Persisted member ancestry is preserved when rebuilding a respawn. ([#11229](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11229)) ([#11280](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11280))

**The engine moves to senpi 2026.10.25-2: resuming a session interrupted mid-run no longer crashes, startup with many skills is fast again, long sessions keep their prompt cache when the context-budget reminder appears, and the per-request engine turn limit is off by default ([#11240](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11240)).** With 748 skills, startup drops from 83.2 s to 1.4 s, fixing the slow start since 5.1.45 ([#11245](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11245)). In a long session that crossed the reminder at about 714k tokens of context, the request now writes 44k cache tokens instead of 758k. `e

- Memory path-state recovery and commit hooks now keep literal Git lookups working when global glob or case-insensitive pathspec modes are enabled ([#11130](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11130), [#11167](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11167)). (batch [#11187](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11187))

**A user Stop pauses the workflow run it started instead of cancelling it.** DAG nodes, workpool workers and task children hold where they are; a message to the paused run or Resume continues it from where it stopped. ([#10808](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10808), fixes [#6752](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/6752)) (batch [#11187](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11187))

**Concurrent file touches show each project memory nudge once.** Project memory reads reserve the nudge before asynchronous loading, retry failed reads, and discard stale results after compaction or session changes. ([#11165](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11165), addresses item 1 of [#10927](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10927)) (batch [#11187](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11187))

**A finished workflow run now shows as a finished run.** When a workflow (DAG) run started from a session completes, including one that completes after recovery, the engine records the session's completion as a finished run instead of a plain reply ([#11155](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11155)). (batch [#11187](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11187))

**A finished ulw-execute plan now shows as a finished run.** When this session's own ulw-execute work is marked completed, the engine records the session's completion as a finished run instead of a plain reply. Work finished by an earlier run, abandoned work, and another session's work are not counted ([#11174](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11174)). (batch [#11187](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11187))

**A completed ulw-loop plan now shows as a finished run.** When this session's ulw-loop plan reaches its aggregate completion, the engine records the session's completion as a finished run instead of a plain reply. A plan that was already complete when the session started is not counted ([#11175](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11175)). (batch [#11187](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11187))

**CI exposes the lint ratchet as its own required-free status check.** Pull requests, pushes and merge groups run `Lint ratchet` independently of the heavy-validation typecheck path. ([#11128](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11128), thanks @Dante-dan) (batch [#11187](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11187))

**The 10k parked-backlog memory test now fails if it observed no entry reads.** ([#11164](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11164), part of [#11091](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11091), thanks @Dante-dan) (batch [#11187](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11187))

**omo.dev/download no longer answers 404.** Desktop builds link it from the reinstall screen and the .deb update pill; while the site's own download page is off, `/download` and `/<locale>/download` now redirect to the public beta download page at https://get.omo.dev/desktop/beta/. ([#11270](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11270))

**Gateway wakes, UI answers and releases reach a host session known only by its durable id.** A multi-session host refuses any command that names no session, so a wake for a session read from disk or found by `thread locate` was lost with `missing_session_id`. The client now looks the session up on its host by durable id and routes the command; when no live session holds it, the delivery stays queued for

**OmO Native init-deep committed mode no longer dead-ends.** Committed mode now finishes through its own pull-request handoff instead of pointing at a skill that does not ship with OmO Native, and it reports how to finish by hand when no PR can be opened. Thanks to @HolisticDeveloper for the report and @surlymochan for the fix. ([#11228](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11228), fixes [#9686](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9686))

**The stale-reflection-lock test leaves no background writer behind when removing its temporary root.** Its teardown closes the memory wiring and awaits facts reconciliation and maintenance before removal, so a late lock publication cannot recreate the directory and make the temp-leak guard blame another test. ([#11225](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11225))

**ulw-research ships a Markdown block model for checking Markdown and post deliverables.** It splits a Markdown report into headings, paragraphs, list items, table rows, code blocks and quotes with exact text offsets, and sorts sections with the same classifier as the HTML checks; an unclosed code fence is reported instead of passing silently, and no check uses it yet. The HTML checks now also treat a section headed exactly "Closing" as the closing section. ([#11153](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11153), part of [#11009](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11009))

**ulw-research ships checked polish edits and a polish diff for research reports.** Polish changes text nodes only: tags, every attribute, comments, and script/style/template content stay byte-identical, including attribute order and quoting. `polish-apply` rejects markup changes and edits that change a fact, number, unit, ticker, or required hedge, and checks cumulative edits against the original report; `polish-diff` applies the same rules to the whole report. An edit may not contain `<`, `>` or `&`, and may not touch a character reference even without them; both gates also compare the whole-document skeleton (every markup token and every character reference, byte for byte), so entities and markup are left untouched. Both gates refuse documents with markup the checker cannot model exactly. Markup changes require the full fidelity gates. Severities come from the defect registry. Nothing in the CLI calls them yet. ([#11152](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11152), part of [#11009](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11009))

**Re-extracting a conversation no longer counts the same agreement correction again.** Corrections are bound to validated user turns and recorded atomically with their replay receipts. Distinct turns on the same date still count separately; acknowledgement, drop and eviction retain replay history. Pending records from older versions use a documented agreement/date migration. ([#11214](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11214), fixes [#11191](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11191))

**The LSP MCP server negotiates supported protocol versions.** It preserves supported client versions and answers unsupported or missing versions with `2025-06-18`, rather than claiming an arbitrary protocol revision. ([#11208](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11208))

**Skill MCP tool errors are reported as errors.** Structured output and result metadata reach the caller, tool failures are not retried as connection failures, and plain content keeps its existing output format. ([#11207](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11207))

**The repository now has a security policy.** `SECURITY.md` explains how to report a vulnerability privately through GitHub's Security tab, what to include, and when to expect triage and an acknowledgement; `CONTRIBUTING.md` links to it. Adapted from the policy proposed by @marklapointe in [#10752](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-open

**Reading the end of a long session takes 42 ms and 68 MB instead of 40 s and 1.8 GB.** `session_read`, `session_search` and `session_info` page through OpenCode's message API instead of loading the whole session: on a 23,000-message session, `session_read` with `limit: 2, from_end: true` dropped from 39.6 s and 1,848 MB peak memory to 42 ms and 68 MB, and a search that runs out its 60-second timeout now stops reading when it returns, where it used to read another 228 MB in the background ([#10738](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10738), [#10741](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10741)).

**OmO's extension no longer carries an LSP engine it never runs.** The native LSP tools and post-edit diagnostics already go through the packaged LSP daemon, but the formatter's import pulled lsp-core's whole in-process engine into `omo.js`; importing only the helpers it uses shrinks the extension by about 82 KB, with no change in behavior. ([#10659](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10659))

**Every session start reads about 33 KB less of `omo.js`: eleven memory slash commands and memory sync's device account load on first use ([#10902](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10902), [#10860](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10860)).** The commands (`/memory`, `/remember`, `/init`, `/recompile`, `/memory-repository`, `/sleeptime`, `/reflect`, `/dream`, `/search`, `/facts`, `/agreements`) still appear at startup with the same names, descriptions and hints; their handlers load from `extensions/omo-memory-commands.js`. The signed-in device account loads from `extensions/omo-device-account.js` the first time a session resolves its sync, and if that file cannot load, memory sync reports `sync-unavailable` with the reason instead of looking signed out.

**ulw-research ships a fact ledger, a fidelity state file and a claim index for research reports.** They give each research run a machine-readable record of its facts and verified claims; nothing in the CLI uses them yet. ([#11046](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11046), part of [#11009](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11009); batch [#11148](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11148))

**Child-task, workflow and workpool wake sources report kind `children`.** ([#11114](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11114), part of [#10782](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10782))

**An unreadable workpool store no longer drops or falsely clears the children wake source.** ([#11118](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11118), part of [#10782](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10782))

**The children wake source reads the workpool store once per snapshot.** ([#11124](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11124), part of [#10782](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10782)) (batch [#11148](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11148))

**Child results waiting in the wake queue keep the parent from reading as done.** ([#11115](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11115), part of [#10782](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10782))

**The wake-queue count can no longer cost a delivery receipt and is re-published per session generation.** ([#11121](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11121), part of [#10782](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10782))

**A receipt that throws no longer leaves the wake-queue count up.** ([#11122](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11122), part of [#10782](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10782))

**Delivery receipts are isolated from each other, on retire too, and no receipt error is dropped.** ([#11123](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11123), part of [#10782](https://github.
